MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH CROSS-REFERENCE DEFECTS

SECTION 1. SCOPE OF SERVICES
1.1 Provider shall perform the services outlined in Exhibit A attached hereto.
1.2 Provider shall also maintain backup archives pursuant to Exhibit C (Data Backup SLA).

SECTION 2. FEES AND PAYMENTS
2.1 Client shall pay fees in accordance with Section 8.3 of this Agreement.
2.2 Expenses shall be reimbursed as described in Schedule 3.

SECTION 3. TERM AND RENEWAL
3.1 The term of this Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date.
3.2 Renewal shall be subject to the terms in Clause 14.2 herein.

SECTION 4. REMEDIES AND DEFAULT
4.1 In the event of default, the non-defaulting party may exercise the remedies set forth in the preceding Section.
4.2 Liability limits shall apply as defined in Section 8.1.

SECTION 8. INDEMNIFICATION
8.1 Indemnification Scope. Provider shall indemnify Client for intellectual property claims.
8.2 Notice of Claim. Client must provide prompt notice of any claim within ten (10) days.

SECTION 14. MISCELLANEOUS
This Section 14 contains the general boilerplate provisions.

Provider services description.
